brief: The wind has a sign since #71 and three consumers still do not know. c108: rain drops slant −x on every day (r.x -= v·dt·0.12 in the shower step, drawn as a −2.4 px line) — the one weather consumer that ignores windSign; put the slant on windDir() so an east wind blows the rain east. c109: leaves from the west street tree (pit x=8) blow off-world under a negative sign (l.x < −10 in 7/10 seeds; motion gate 'leaf oob' fires on HEAD) — kill them at the frame edge. c110: every lane leaf lands in road row 70 because fall y-drift is a constant 0.5/s; give each leaf a small per-leaf y term at spawn so the drift spreads across gutter and crown (then #72's sweeper.gutter row choice is a real choice).
successLooksLike: Rain slants with the sign in a crop at each sign; the motion gate's leaf-oob fault is gone on ten seeds; road litter spans 3+ rows with row 70 still the heaviest; every #71/#72 anchor identical at sign +1.
avoid: No new R() draws in the shower step (the rain is a population). Do not change leaf counts or fall speed.
